text: {"lessons":["I will not sell a stock just because it has risen above my average cost; I should weigh its outlook, valuation, and role in my portfolio before taking profits.","Stock E’s large loss and repeated sales remind me that avoiding a painful loss can delay an objective decision, while finally selling under pressure can be just as reactive. I will reassess positions using current evidence, not my cost basis.","My purchases of Stocks B, C, and D did not prevent the account from fluctuating. I will size trades carefully and judge each decision in the context of portfolio risk and longer-term goals, not short-term account moves."]}
